trading_mode.description: Set to true for PAPER trading (no real money), false for LIVE trading

bot_capital.description: Total capital allocated to bot ($). Start small: $100-500 for live trading

trading_parameters.description: Risk management: max 4 open positions, 1 new per week

circuit_breakers.description: Auto-stop trading if portfolio loses 5%, manual review at 8%, halt at 10%

approval_settings.description: Require manual approval for all trades (safety feature)

notes.switching_to_live: Set paper_trading to false ONLY after 12 weeks of paper testing
notes.monitoring: Check dashboard daily during first 2 weeks of live trading
notes.contact: Keep MooMoo OpenD logged in and running at port 11112
